May 19, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Hilton Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Weibo Corp Adr (WB) by 243.04% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hilton Capital Management Llc bought 9,600 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.68% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 13,550 shares of the programming company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.40 million, up from 3,950 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hilton Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Weibo Corp Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.63B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.18% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $101.62. About 1.61 million shares traded. Weibo Corporation (NASDAQ:WB) has risen 132.32% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 120.77% the S&P500.
Paradice Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Capstead Mtg Corp (CMO) by 1.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Paradice Investment Management Llc bought 103,773 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.47% with the market. The institutional investor held 5.79 million shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.13M, up from 5.69M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Paradice Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Capstead Mtg Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $841.26 million market cap company. The stock increased 1.11% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $9.1. About 633,821 shares traded or 3.56% up from the average. Capstead Mortgage Corporation (NYSE:CMO) has declined 17.75% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.30% the S&P500.
